snippet.title: The One Rule That Keeps Him Alive #TimeLoop #SciFi
snippet.description:
In the training scene from Edge of Tomorrow (2014), Rita tells Cage what he must do if he gets badly injured in a fight. The time loop makes her one rule possible.

Music: “Constance” by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
